title: 第14章
content:
小夜回到自己房间，久久不能平静，半晌终于咬牙切齿的盘坐在床上修炼起来，天下哪有容易的事，小夜在后半宿就迷迷糊糊的睡着了，什么灵气，根本感应不到。早上，又是几个仆人把他拉起来的。“小少爷，老爷出门了，你别贪床，该吃饭了，老爷走前说了，不让你拉下功课，让老奴督促着呢，一会儿西席李先生就要来了赶紧准备一下。”“不是说好了三天来一次吗”“今天就是第三天啊，快点吃饭，学具已经准备好了，已经放到正屋了，”“好了，好了，知道了，吴伯！”饭毕，小夜在正屋坐下不久，李先生带着自家孩子李儒是来了，小夜起身，向西席李先生问好“老师好！”李老头已过花甲，清瘦，精神矍铄。其子李儒是也坐到小夜身边，也算是一种伴读吧，老先生没有多余的话，直接开课，讲的就是一些儒家经典，引用了一点历史名人典故，教了一些基础算术、度量衡等等，小夜心思早不在这里了，满脑子里是仙术、灵草……“佳小夜！施于人而不事，是之，实之。何解？”“啊！这个，这个……”小夜支支吾吾半天，回答不上来，李老头一吹胡子，拿起戒尺说道“伸手”。孩子一激灵，乖乖的伸手。“啪，啪，啪！”小夜龇牙咧嘴，每打一下，旁边小儒是哆嗦一下。“坐下，上课专心，不懂勤问”。“老师，我想问下，啥是天人感应，啥是人体叩关，还有，这个，这个…嗯…冥想是啥意思？”西席李老头楞了一下，怔怔地看着小夜，说到“孩子，你这几天看了些啥书，你现在不应该了解这些东西的，我知道这些，不一定对，也说不好，怕误导你，我谈一点自己看法，具体的、真实的你自己以后慢慢揣摸。”接下来，李老师就小夜的一些问题作出了回答。一个问，一个答。不知不觉一上午过去了，旁边的小孩儒是惊讶不止。中午，佣人叫大家用餐，先生和学生不在一处吃，餐毕，先生要去里屋小憩一会儿，俩孩子不睡觉，李儒是问小夜道“你最近看啥书了，不问妖魔鬼怪了，也不问典故了，”“你不懂，我要当神仙”小夜老神在在的说，满脸幢景。“切，你快算了吧！不考状元了，不当大将军了，不要金银珠宝了？别说那些没用的，别整那没影的，来点实惠的，请我吃顿好的。”“小事，明天，哦，不，后天，后天你来找我，我们叫上柱子、大壮、小东、大牛、二牛一起去镇上，好好吃一顿，主要就是我找小东他哥旺财有事。”“镖局里的那个趟子手，旺财？”李儒是仰着个脸问道。“嗯，就是，他是小东堂哥，问个事。你想好咱们吃啥就行”小夜回答道。俩孩子有一句没一句的聊天，互相约好了那天摸鱼，那天抓鸟，那天偷瓜。一会儿，时辰到，李老头要继续讲课，下午，先生说了一些持之以恒、滴水穿石、勤能补拙的大道理，讲了一点生字，生词，就结束了。老了，累啊，真不想教了，没办法啊，东家给的钱高啊！大儿子没考上功名，高不成低不就，现在连媳妇都没说上，小儿子比小夜大一岁，老头年轻时候为考功名把几亩薄田给卖出去了，没啥营生，大儿子在镇上教书，刚刚养活自己，唉！愁人啊！晚上，小夜又他娘的白忙活了半夜，啥感也没有。第二天，孩子起来看书，练字，画画，打王八拳。晚上，唉！晚上又白晚上了！第三天，早早起来，餐毕，找管家吴伯要银子。

“少爷，不是老奴不给，你要的太多了，十两，能买几头牛，一两好不好，老爷不在，我不敢啊，什么，八两，最多二两。”“吴伯，我今天要办大事，二两够个屁啊？我买书，对，买好多书，笔，墨，纸，还要请客，别操心，我们好几个人呢，这样吧，你多给点，我花不完，就拿回来，我记着账呢，好不好？”吴伯一咬牙，伸出来一只手，道“最多五两，另外，叫丫鬟大玉儿跟着，老奴不放心，出了事，老爷不扒了我的皮啊。”“什么？大玉儿姐，她去干什么，不行，一个女娃娃，我们都是男爷们，你去干啥？她去才容易出事呢，她看着我们，还不够丢人的呢，”小夜急了。“几个屁大的孩子，谁看你们啊，男爷们？要不就别去，别想拿银子。”吴伯笑咪咪的就像条老狗。“大玉儿路上还能侍奉少爷你，有个跟班丫鬟，你脸上才有光哩。”反正，小夜死活不松口，就是不让丫鬟去，而且必须拿到银两。“镇子离咱村又不远，我们一年跑八趟，路过好几个村子，路上尽是人，有屁的不放心啊！”二人搪塞、推拿、拉扯了半天，终于，还是少爷占了上风。丫鬟不用去，最多五两银子。吴伯让丫鬟把其中的四两缝到小夜内衣里，剩余一两放到兜里。小夜嘟嘟囔囔的到门口等李儒是去了，吴老狗眯着一双小眼睛，看着少爷背影，叹道“五两，五两啊，够村里人一家子半年开销了。”随后，吴老狗一沉思，大声叫道“钢子，钢子！你来一下，我有事交代。”不一小会儿，钢子来了，钢子是个厨子，手里还拿着刷子和抹布。“吴管家，您老啥事？”吴管家摇头晃脑的说“钢子，你放下手里的活，去跟着少爷，他和几个孩子去镇上耍去了，你别露头，别让少爷瞧见你，暗暗跟上，最主要的是别让少爷出事，有人欺负他们，你再出面，把孩子们领回来。”“不去，我有好多活没干完呢，”钢子也是个犟驴。“放屁！啥活？让大玉儿干了，你到厨房里拿几个熟地瓜和馍馍，路上自个吃，少爷有银子，不用你管。”“管家，少爷每年去好几次，不啥事都没有嘛。好几个孩子呢，镇子又不远，路上人来人往的。”钢子还是不想去。“你懂了屁，这次少爷身上有五两银子呢，不怕他花钱，就怕他露财，被几个小地痞欺负，你办好了差事，回头到年底，我让老爷多给你半吊子大子儿。”一吊子是500个铜钱，半吊子就是二百五……个大子儿。吴老狗又拿出三两银子道“你拿上，万一少爷钱花的不够了，你就出面，给少爷解围，如果没有用上，你给我再交回来，明白吧？”钢子挠挠头，接过银子，去厨房拿了葫芦装水，背了个褡裢，出门了。村口，大牛、二牛、柱子、大壮、小东五个孩子就等着小夜和儒是两人呢。不一会儿功夫，两兔崽子出现。大家就一窝蜂的冲向小镇。路上，小夜先把那一两银子掏出来，让大伙儿看个明白，小伙伴们一阵惊呼，太了不起了！大家把小夜拥在当中，这个说要吃糖葫芦，那个说吃糖人，有的说吃丸子面，有的说买玩具。佳大少爷趾高气扬，腿脚抬的老高，走路那真叫一个摇头摆尾，像是县太爷出访。这一路人马，浩浩荡荡，威风凛凛，半道上，狗都不敢叫，树上蝉都哆嗦。约莫着一里之外，钢子贼头贼脑、缩手缩脚地跟上了。路过河边小山丘，佳大少一挥手，道“上面有几窝鸟，前几次路过没功夫，今天掏了它！”孩子们铺天盖地的跑向山腰。于是，半山腰上又一阵子尘土飞扬，树叶四溅，兔子是追不上的！肥肥的大雁嘎嘎直叫。一会儿功夫，小土匪们下山了，有两个鼻青眼肿的，是从树上跌下来的，还有几个衣服被树杈挂烂，大壮手里提着条死蛇，二牛衣服口袋里全是野果子，佳大少抹掉嘴上的几根鸟毛，骂骂咧咧的走在前面，李儒是怀里有两只毛茸茸的小鸟边走边说“这东西能养活？它吃啥呀？”小土匪们一路走走停停，一会上树，一会儿下河，一会儿偷瓜，一会儿撵狗。反正就是弯弯绕绕不走直线，有路不走，哪里没路走哪里，钢子在后面累的像狗一样喘气，一只鞋子也湿了，葫芦里的水早喝干了，嗓子冒火，咬牙切齿的跟上。二三十里的路走的快中午了，才望见小镇的轮廓。土匪们也饿了，决定先去找旺财哥，然后去饭馆，好好的吃一顿。镖局大门口，太阳把两头石狮子晒的浑身发烫，小东上前到门房巅起脚对里面人喊“旺财是我哥，我刚刚从村子里来，让我哥出来一下，找他有大事。”“哦，是旺财的弟弟？旺财去刘老爷家送请柬了，一会儿吃饭的时候就回来了，你们在门口阴凉处等着吧。”孩子们也不知道等到啥时候，小夜安排了一下，自己和大牛，柱子去趟医馆，这两个家伙手上脸上擦破了，去上点药，小东留在镖局门口等他哥，剩下的几个去饭堂，提前找个好座位，顺便看看菜单，就去最大的饭馆东福堂。医馆，伙计给两个小屁孩包扎，佳大少爷请教白胡子老神医，问一些筋络问题，老爷子有问必答，主要还是看在小夜买了不少书籍的面子上。半个时辰不到，小夜带着二人拿着书籍，裤兜装着一把找回的散钱，去了东福堂，钢子屁颠屁颠的跟在后面不远处，“你们在门口干啥，咋不进去？”

Xiaoye returned to her room and couldn't calm down for a long time. After a while, she finally sat cross-legged on the bed and started to practice. Nothing in the world is easy. Xiaoye fell asleep in a daze in the second half of the night. She couldn't sense any spiritual energy at all.In the morning, several servants pulled him up again."Young Master, I'm going out. Don't be greedy for bed. It's time to eat. I told you before I left that you won't be allowed to miss your homework. I'm letting the old slave supervise you. Teacher Mr. Li will be here soon and prepare quickly." "Didn't we agree to come once every three days?" "Today is the third day. Hurry up and eat. Learn more.It's ready and has been placed in the main room." "Okay, okay, I understand, Uncle Wu!" After dinner, not long after Xiaoye sat down in the main room, Mr. Li came with his child Li Ru. Xiaoye got up and said hello to the teacher, Mr. Li, "Hello, teacher!" Old Li was already in his sixties, thin and energetic.His son Li Ru also sat next to Xiao Ye, and he could be regarded as a kind of companion. The old man didn't have any extra words to say, so he started the class directly. He taught some Confucian classics, quoted some historical celebrities, and taught some basic arithmetic, weights and measures, etc. Xiao Ye's mind was no longer there.Here, my mind is full of fairy magic and spiritual herbs... "Jia Xiaoye! Applying to others without doing anything, it is what it is, what it is. What's the explanation?" "Ah! This, this..." Xiaoye hesitated for a long time, unable to answer. Old man Li blew his beard, picked up the ruler and said, "reach out."The child was excited and obediently stretched out his hand."Pah, pah, pah!" Xiao Ye bared her teeth, and Xiaoru next to her trembled with every blow."Sit down, concentrate in class, don't know how to ask questions frequently.""Teacher, I would like to ask, what is heavenly induction, what is human body knocking, and, this, this... um... what does meditation mean?" Teacher Li was stunned for a moment, looked at Xiao Ye blankly, and said, "Child, what books have you read these days, what are you reading now?You shouldn't know these things. I know this, but it may not be correct, and I can't say it well. I'm afraid I might mislead you. I'll give you my own opinions.You can figure out the specific and true details later." Next, Teacher Li answered some of Xiaoye's questions.One question, one answer.Unknowingly, the morning passed, and the child next to him was surprised.At noon, the servant asked everyone to have dinner. The husband and the students did not eat together. After the meal, the husband had to go to the back room to take a nap. The two children were not sleeping. Li Ru asked Xiaoye, "What have you been reading recently? You no longer ask about monsters, ghosts, and allusions." "You don't understand, I want to be a god," Xiaoye said with a smile on his face."Tch, forget it now! You don't want to take the No. 1 exam, you don't want to be a general, you don't want gold, silver, and jewelry? Don't talk about those useless things, don't deal with the invisible ones, come with something affordable, treat me to a nice meal." "It's a small matter, tomorrow, oh, no, the day after tomorrow, the day after tomorrow.You come to me, and we invite Zhuzhu, Da Zhuang, Xiaodong, Daniu and Erniu to go to town together and have a good meal.The main reason is that I have something to do with Xiaodong's brother Wangcai." "That troublemaker in the escort agency, Wangcai?" Li Ru asked with a raised face."Well, that's right, he is Xiaodong's cousin, let me ask you something. Just think about what we will eat," Xiaoye replied.The two children chatted without a word, and made an appointment with each other to fish, catch birds, and steal melons that day.After a while, the time came, and Old Man Li wanted to continue his lecture. In the afternoon, the teacher talked about some great principles about perseverance, dripping water piercing stone, and diligence can make up for one's weakness. He also talked about some new words and new words, and that was the end.I'm old and tired. I really don't want to teach anymore. I have no choice. The money offered by my employer is so high!The eldest son has not been admitted to the imperial examination. He has not been able to make a living, and now he has not even found a wife. The younger son is one year older than Xiaoye. When the old man was young, he sold several acres of thin farmland in order to obtain the imperial examination. There is no way to make a living. The eldest son is teaching in the town and has just supported himself. Alas!What a worry!In the evening, Xiaoye worked so damn hard for half the night that she felt nothing.The next day, the children got up to read, practice calligraphy, draw, and do boxing.At night, alas!The night is in vain again!On the third day, I got up early, finished my meal, and asked Uncle Wu, the housekeeper, for some money.

"Master, it's not that I don't want to give it to you. You want too much. Ten taels. How many cows can you buy? One tael. I don't dare if the master is not here. What, eight taels, two taels at most." "Uncle Wu, I have something big to do today. Two taels is enough. I'm buying books. Yes, I bought a lot of books, pens, ink, and paper. I also have to treat guests. Don't worry. There are several of us. How about this? You can give me more. If I can't spend it all, I'll take it back. IKeep track of the account, okay?" Uncle Wu gritted his teeth, stretched out his hand and said, "Five taels at most.Also, ask the maid Da Yu'er to follow.I don't worry, if something happens, I won't take my skin off." "What? Sister Da Yu'er, what is she going to do? It's a girl.What are you going to do? It's easy for her to go. It's not embarrassing enough for her to look at us.""Those big kids, who cares about you, men? Otherwise, don't go, don't even think about getting any money." Uncle Wu smiled like an old dog."Da Yu'er can still serve you young master on the way. You have a maid as your attendant, so your face will be bright." Anyway, Xiao Ye refused to let go, and she refused to let the maid go, and she had to get some silver."The town is not far from our village. We make eight trips a year and pass by several villages. The roads are full of people, so don't worry!" The two of them prevaricated, massaged, and pulled for a long time. Finally, the young master gained the upper hand.The maid doesn't have to go, the most she can get is five taels of silver.Uncle Wu asked the maid to sew four taels of them into Xiao Ye's underwear and put the remaining one tael in his pocket.Xiaoye mumbled to the door and waited for Li Ru to go. Wu Laogou squinted his little eyes, looked at the young master's back, and sighed, "Five taels, five taels, it's enough for the villagers' family for half a year." Then, Wu Laogou thought deeply and shouted loudly, "Gangzi, Gangzi! Come here, I have something to explain." After a while, Gangzi came. Gangzi was a cook, holding a brush and a rag in his hand."Steward Wu, what's the matter with you?" Steward Wu shook his head and said, "Gangzi, put down what you are doing and follow the young master. He and a few children have gone to play in the town. Don't show your head, don't let the young master see you, follow him secretly. The most important thing is not to let the young master get into trouble. If someone bullies them, you come forward and bring the children back." "No, I have a lot of unfinished work," Gangzi is also a stubborn donkey."Fart! What kind of work? Let Dayu'er do it. You go to the kitchen and get some cooked sweet potatoes and steamed buns. You can eat them by yourself on the way. The young master has money, so you don't have to worry about it." "Butler, the young master goes there several times a year, but nothing happens. There are several children, and the town is not far away, and there are people coming and going on the road." Gangzi still didn't want to go."You understand, this time the young master has five taels of silver. I am not afraid of him spending it, but I am afraid that he will reveal his wealth and be bullied by a few gangsters. After you finish the errand, at the end of the year, I will ask the master to give you more half-baked coins." A shilling is 500 copper coins, and a half-baked coin is 250... big boys.Wu Laogou took out another three taels of silver and said, "Take it. If the young master doesn't spend enough money, you will come forward to help the young master. If it is not used, you will give it back to me, understand?" Gangzi scratched his head, took the silver, went to the kitchen to get a gourd to fill with water, carried a robe on his back, and went out.At the entrance of the village, five children, Daniu, Erniu, Zhuzhu, Dazhuang, and Xiaodong, were waiting for Xiaoye and Ru.After a while, two bastards appeared.Everyone rushed to the town in droves.On the way, Xiaoye first took out the one tael of silver and showed it to everyone. The friends exclaimed, "It's amazing!"Everyone gathered around Xiaoye, one said they wanted to eat candied haws, another said they wanted to eat candy, some said they wanted to eat meatball noodles, and some said they wanted to buy toys.Young Master Jiada is very arrogant, with his legs and feet raised high, and he is really shaking his head and tail when he walks, as if the county magistrate is on a visit.The people and horses along the way were vast and majestic. Halfway along the way, no dogs dared to bark, and the cicadas on the trees were trembling.About a mile away, Gang Zi followed up in a cowardly manner.Passing by the hill beside the river, Young Master Jia waved his hand and said, "There are a few nests of birds up there. I didn't have time to pass by them the last few times, so I picked them up today!" The children ran towards the mountainside in overwhelming numbers.So, the dust was flying again on the mountainside for a while, the leaves were flying, and the rabbit couldn't catch up!The fat geese are quacking.After a while, the little bandits came down the mountain. Two of them had black noses and swollen eyes. They fell from the tree. There were also a few whose clothes were hung to pieces by tree branches. Da Zhuang was holding a dead snake in his hand. Er Niu's pockets were full of wild fruits. Young Master Jia wiped a few bird sticks from his mouth.Mao walked in front, cursing, while Li Ru held two fluffy birds in his arms and said as he walked, "Can this thing be fed? What does it eat?" The little bandits stopped and walked along the way, sometimes climbing trees, sometimes going down to rivers, sometimes stealing melons, and sometimes chasing dogs.Anyway, it was just twists and turns, unable to walk in a straight line, there was no road, and there was no road. Gangzi was panting like a dog behind, one of his shoes was wet, the water in the gourd had been drunk long ago, his throat was on fire, and he gritted his teeth to keep up.After walking twenty or thirty miles, it was almost noon before we saw the outline of the town.The bandits were also hungry, so they decided to go to Brother Wangcai first, and then go to the restaurant to have a good meal.At the gate of the Escort Bureau, the sun made the two stone lions hot all over. Xiaodong stepped forward to the concierge and stood up on his feet and shouted to the people inside, "Wangcai is my brother. I just came from the village. I asked my brother to come out and find something important to do with him." "Oh, is he Wangcai's younger brother? Wangcai went to Master Liu's house to deliver invitations. He will be back later during dinner. You guys are at the door.Let's wait in the shade." The children didn't know when to wait. Xiaoye made arrangements. She, Danniu and Zhuzi went to the medical clinic. The two guys had scratches on their hands and faces and went to get some medicine. Xiaodong stayed at the door of the escort office and waited for his brother. The rest went to the canteen, found a good seat in advance, took a look at the menu, and went to the largest restaurant, Dongfutang.In the medical clinic, the waiter bandaged two little kids. Young Master Jiada consulted the old miracle doctor with a white beard and asked some questions about muscles. The old man answered all the questions, mainly because Xiaoye bought a lot of books.Less than half an hour later, Xiaoye took the two of them to Dongfu Hall with books and a handful of loose money in their trouser pockets. Gangzi followed not far behind, "What are you doing at the door? Why don't you go in?"

小夜回到自己房间，久久不能平静，半晌终于咬牙切齿的盘坐在床上修炼起来，天下哪有容易的事，小夜在后半宿就迷迷糊糊的睡着了，什么灵气，根本感应不到。早上，又是几个仆人把他拉起来的。“小少爷，老爷出门了，你别贪床，该吃饭了，老爷走前说了，不让你拉下功课，让老奴督促着呢，一会儿西席李先生就要来了赶紧准备一下。”“不是说好了三天来一次吗”“今天就是第三天啊，快点吃饭，学具已经准备好了，已经放到正屋了，”“好了，好了，知道了，吴伯！”饭毕，小夜在正屋坐下不久，李先生带着自家孩子李儒是来了，小夜起身，向西席李先生问好“老师好！”李老头已过花甲，清瘦，精神矍铄。其子李儒是也坐到小夜身边，也算是一种伴读吧，老先生没有多余的话，直接开课，讲的就是一些儒家经典，引用了一点历史名人典故，教了一些基础算术、度量衡等等，小夜心思早不在这里了，满脑子里是仙术、灵草……“佳小夜！施于人而不事，是之，实之。何解？”“啊！这个，这个……”小夜支支吾吾半天，回答不上来，李老头一吹胡子，拿起戒尺说道“伸手”。孩子一激灵，乖乖的伸手。“啪，啪，啪！”小夜龇牙咧嘴，每打一下，旁边小儒是哆嗦一下。“坐下，上课专心，不懂勤问”。“老师，我想问下，啥是天人感应，啥是人体叩关，还有，这个，这个…嗯…冥想是啥意思？”西席李老头楞了一下，怔怔地看着小夜，说到“孩子，你这几天看了些啥书，你现在不应该了解这些东西的，我知道这些，不一定对，也说不好，怕误导你，我谈一点自己看法，具体的、真实的你自己以后慢慢揣摸。”接下来，李老师就小夜的一些问题作出了回答。一个问，一个答。不知不觉一上午过去了，旁边的小孩儒是惊讶不止。中午，佣人叫大家用餐，先生和学生不在一处吃，餐毕，先生要去里屋小憩一会儿，俩孩子不睡觉，李儒是问小夜道“你最近看啥书了，不问妖魔鬼怪了，也不问典故了，”“你不懂，我要当神仙”小夜老神在在的说，满脸幢景。“切，你快算了吧！不考状元了，不当大将军了，不要金银珠宝了？别说那些没用的，别整那没影的，来点实惠的，请我吃顿好的。”“小事，明天，哦，不，后天，后天你来找我，我们叫上柱子、大壮、小东、大牛、二牛一起去镇上，好好吃一顿，主要就是我找小东他哥旺财有事。”“镖局里的那个趟子手，旺财？”李儒是仰着个脸问道。“嗯，就是，他是小东堂哥，问个事。你想好咱们吃啥就行”小夜回答道。俩孩子有一句没一句的聊天，互相约好了那天摸鱼，那天抓鸟，那天偷瓜。一会儿，时辰到，李老头要继续讲课，下午，先生说了一些持之以恒、滴水穿石、勤能补拙的大道理，讲了一点生字，生词，就结束了。老了，累啊，真不想教了，没办法啊，东家给的钱高啊！大儿子没考上功名，高不成低不就，现在连媳妇都没说上，小儿子比小夜大一岁，老头年轻时候为考功名把几亩薄田给卖出去了，没啥营生，大儿子在镇上教书，刚刚养活自己，唉！愁人啊！晚上，小夜又他娘的白忙活了半夜，啥感也没有。第二天，孩子起来看书，练字，画画，打王八拳。晚上，唉！晚上又白晚上了！第三天，早早起来，餐毕，找管家吴伯要银子。

“少爷，不是老奴不给，你要的太多了，十两，能买几头牛，一两好不好，老爷不在，我不敢啊，什么，八两，最多二两。”“吴伯，我今天要办大事，二两够个屁啊？我买书，对，买好多书，笔，墨，纸，还要请客，别操心，我们好几个人呢，这样吧，你多给点，我花不完，就拿回来，我记着账呢，好不好？”吴伯一咬牙，伸出来一只手，道“最多五两，另外，叫丫鬟大玉儿跟着，老奴不放心，出了事，老爷不扒了我的皮啊。”“什么？大玉儿姐，她去干什么，不行，一个女娃娃，我们都是男爷们，你去干啥？她去才容易出事呢，她看着我们，还不够丢人的呢，”小夜急了。“几个屁大的孩子，谁看你们啊，男爷们？要不就别去，别想拿银子。”吴伯笑咪咪的就像条老狗。“大玉儿路上还能侍奉少爷你，有个跟班丫鬟，你脸上才有光哩。”反正，小夜死活不松口，就是不让丫鬟去，而且必须拿到银两。“镇子离咱村又不远，我们一年跑八趟，路过好几个村子，路上尽是人，有屁的不放心啊！”二人搪塞、推拿、拉扯了半天，终于，还是少爷占了上风。丫鬟不用去，最多五两银子。吴伯让丫鬟把其中的四两缝到小夜内衣里，剩余一两放到兜里。小夜嘟嘟囔囔的到门口等李儒是去了，吴老狗眯着一双小眼睛，看着少爷背影，叹道“五两，五两啊，够村里人一家子半年开销了。”随后，吴老狗一沉思，大声叫道“钢子，钢子！你来一下，我有事交代。”不一小会儿，钢子来了，钢子是个厨子，手里还拿着刷子和抹布。“吴管家，您老啥事？”吴管家摇头晃脑的说“钢子，你放下手里的活，去跟着少爷，他和几个孩子去镇上耍去了，你别露头，别让少爷瞧见你，暗暗跟上，最主要的是别让少爷出事，有人欺负他们，你再出面，把孩子们领回来。”“不去，我有好多活没干完呢，”钢子也是个犟驴。“放屁！啥活？让大玉儿干了，你到厨房里拿几个熟地瓜和馍馍，路上自个吃，少爷有银子，不用你管。”“管家，少爷每年去好几次，不啥事都没有嘛。好几个孩子呢，镇子又不远，路上人来人往的。”钢子还是不想去。“你懂了屁，这次少爷身上有五两银子呢，不怕他花钱，就怕他露财，被几个小地痞欺负，你办好了差事，回头到年底，我让老爷多给你半吊子大子儿。”一吊子是500个铜钱，半吊子就是二百五……个大子儿。吴老狗又拿出三两银子道“你拿上，万一少爷钱花的不够了，你就出面，给少爷解围，如果没有用上，你给我再交回来，明白吧？”钢子挠挠头，接过银子，去厨房拿了葫芦装水，背了个褡裢，出门了。村口，大牛、二牛、柱子、大壮、小东五个孩子就等着小夜和儒是两人呢。不一会儿功夫，两兔崽子出现。大家就一窝蜂的冲向小镇。路上，小夜先把那一两银子掏出来，让大伙儿看个明白，小伙伴们一阵惊呼，太了不起了！大家把小夜拥在当中，这个说要吃糖葫芦，那个说吃糖人，有的说吃丸子面，有的说买玩具。佳大少爷趾高气扬，腿脚抬的老高，走路那真叫一个摇头摆尾，像是县太爷出访。这一路人马，浩浩荡荡，威风凛凛，半道上，狗都不敢叫，树上蝉都哆嗦。约莫着一里之外，钢子贼头贼脑、缩手缩脚地跟上了。路过河边小山丘，佳大少一挥手，道“上面有几窝鸟，前几次路过没功夫，今天掏了它！”孩子们铺天盖地的跑向山腰。于是，半山腰上又一阵子尘土飞扬，树叶四溅，兔子是追不上的！肥肥的大雁嘎嘎直叫。一会儿功夫，小土匪们下山了，有两个鼻青眼肿的，是从树上跌下来的，还有几个衣服被树杈挂烂，大壮手里提着条死蛇，二牛衣服口袋里全是野果子，佳大少抹掉嘴上的几根鸟毛，骂骂咧咧的走在前面，李儒是怀里有两只毛茸茸的小鸟边走边说“这东西能养活？它吃啥呀？”小土匪们一路走走停停，一会上树，一会儿下河，一会儿偷瓜，一会儿撵狗。反正就是弯弯绕绕不走直线，有路不走，哪里没路走哪里，钢子在后面累的像狗一样喘气，一只鞋子也湿了，葫芦里的水早喝干了，嗓子冒火，咬牙切齿的跟上。二三十里的路走的快中午了，才望见小镇的轮廓。土匪们也饿了，决定先去找旺财哥，然后去饭馆，好好的吃一顿。镖局大门口，太阳把两头石狮子晒的浑身发烫，小东上前到门房巅起脚对里面人喊“旺财是我哥，我刚刚从村子里来，让我哥出来一下，找他有大事。”“哦，是旺财的弟弟？旺财去刘老爷家送请柬了，一会儿吃饭的时候就回来了，你们在门口阴凉处等着吧。”孩子们也不知道等到啥时候，小夜安排了一下，自己和大牛，柱子去趟医馆，这两个家伙手上脸上擦破了，去上点药，小东留在镖局门口等他哥，剩下的几个去饭堂，提前找个好座位，顺便看看菜单，就去最大的饭馆东福堂。医馆，伙计给两个小屁孩包扎，佳大少爷请教白胡子老神医，问一些筋络问题，老爷子有问必答，主要还是看在小夜买了不少书籍的面子上。半个时辰不到，小夜带着二人拿着书籍，裤兜装着一把找回的散钱，去了东福堂，钢子屁颠屁颠的跟在后面不远处，“你们在门口干啥，咋不进去？”
